visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of a massive whale shark swimming slowly through the deep blue water of a Churaumi Aquarium tank, surrounded by schools of smaller fish. (2) The scene cuts to the exterior of American Depot at dusk, featuring vibrant red neon signage and elaborate Christmas decorations including snowmen and wreaths on a multi-story building. (3) A view from a moving vehicle captures a scenic coastline with turquoise water and small green islands under an overcast sky. (4) A close-up shot focuses on a textured grey wall with the words 'Manzamo' written in large black characters. (5) A wide shot shows a grassy field at Cape Manzamo where a group of tourists walks along a fenced path overlooking the grey ocean. (6) The camera captures the famous Elephant Trunk Rock, a natural limestone cliff formation jutting out into the sea. (7) A handheld shot from a car shows the Kouri Bridge stretching across the emerald green ocean. (8) Close-up shots of various local products: jars of miso sauce, a box of 'Blue Curry', and a pair of whale shark-themed earrings. (9) A person's hand holds a soft-serve ice cream cone topped with a mint leaf in front of a green field. (10) The camera transitions to the exterior of Churaumi Aquarium featuring a large whale shark statue, then to the 'Kuroshio Sea' tank where a crowd of people is silhouetted against the massive blue water. (11) Detailed shots of a whale shark and several manta rays gliding gracefully through the water. (12) At an outdoor dolphin theater, a dolphin jumps high out of the water near its trainer with a mountain visible across the bay. (13) Underwater shots show sea turtles swimming peacefully, followed by a manatee moving near a colorful ball. (14) The scene shifts to the colorful, Mediterranean-style architecture of American Village with palm trees and bright sunset lighting. (15) A decorated Christmas tree is shown, followed by a playful mural of Pikachu painted on a concrete wall with painted footprints. (16) A group of tourists with luggage is seen boarding a white and blue tour bus on a city street. (17) A digital map displays the island of Okinawa with a red arrow tracing a route from the south to the north. (18) A final scenic shot shows the tour bus driving across a bridge over a beach with light-colored sand and gentle waves. (19) A pink graphic end card appears with social media icons and the website address japanuts.com.
